scene.summary: A low shed holds unfired pots on plank shelves. The large water jar on the center shelf is split from lip to base, and the clay inside it has dried into pale flakes. A stack of unused coil-pots sits intact on the lower shelf. The shed door stands open to the yard. Nothing here says who split the jar, when, or why.
